Aim range · 9–60 m · 150 HP agents

Headline

Agents walk out from cover at every distance with the same 100 health + shields and the same hitbox. Keep your crosshair at head height, kill with as few bullets as you can, and turn away from flashes before they pop.

This range needs a mouse and keyboard. Open it on a computer to play.

Flashes

How often

The curve flare arcs around a corner and pops 0.65 s after you hear it. The hawk glides out, then screeches for 0.55 s before it pops. Turn about 90° away before the pop to dodge it fully, then turn back for the swing.

Examples

In Valorant: Settings → Crosshair → Export Profile Code, then paste it here. Sizes are drawn in real screen pixels, so it matches the game at your native resolution. Lines with firing error follow each gun's spread, a separate ADS crosshair applies while zoomed, and the sniper center dot shows in the scope.
